pages.text: The Album Cover is needed to save space if you have a lot of Music Disc. It can hold up to 9 Music Disc. Interacts with the $(9)Album Jukebox$(), the $(9)Jukebox$(), the Minecart with Jukebox.

pages.title: Album Cover
pages.text: Selecting a specific track is only possible in the $(9)album player$() (which is logical). In all other cases, in order. Add and take tracks in the same way as for $(l:etched/etched_play_boombox)Boombox$().
You cannot change the color of the cover.
